- `TestRelayAnswerPassesOptionOrTextAndBy` (`internal/slicercli/write_test.go`, fake slicer): argv is `relay-run answer RUN QID --option LABEL --by NAME --json`, or `--text TEXT --by NAME`; no `--why`; the engine's own call (`engine.go` about :455) still passes its text.
- `TestDaemonRelayAnswerRefuses` (`internal/daemon/relayanswer_test.go`): unknown project, an ended run, an unknown or already answered question, an option the question does not offer, an empty `By`, and a run linked to an engine run (answered through the engine) are refused with no slicer write.
- `TestDaemonRelayAnswerAlsoAnswersAKeyedOpenAdjRecord`: a question with `key` that `adj check` reports open as #N answers the ledger first, then adj #N with the same option (or text), `Via` `tui`; a decided, closed or missing key answers the ledger only and the result message says why adj was skipped; a project without adj answers the ledger only; an adj failure after the ledger write returns the ledger success and names the adj error in the message.
- `TestExternalQuestionNumberKeyConfirmsThenAnswers` (`internal/tui/relayanswer_test.go`): a live external run with a blocker question; `2` opens a confirm that names the run, `#QID (Title)` and the option (marked `(recommended)` when it is); `n`, `enter` and `esc` send nothing; `y` sends once with the exact params (`Via` `tui`, `By` from `ADJ_DECIDED_BY`); the confirm also says `and adj #N` when the key is open.

- `TestStaleOrLinkedRunQuestionStaysReadOnly`: a stale run keeps only `x end run`; a linked engine run keeps its engine answer path; neither offers the new keys.
- `TestExternalAnswerFreeTextPendingAndMissingBy`: `t` opens the field, `enter review` only for non-empty text, a second key while in flight says pending, an unset `ADJ_DECIDED_BY` refuses with no call, a refusal shows verbatim.
- Goldens `testdata/golden/ledger-answer-confirm-100x30-{color,mono}.txt`.

## Implement

UI slice: UI pass (r14). Tests first. Line anchors are from main at 2f89cbe (2026-10-30); re-anchor them.
1. slicercli. Give `RelayAnswer` (`internal/slicercli/write.go` about :337-341) an option, text and by form (for example a `RelayAnswerSpec{Option, Text, By}`), with no `--why`. Keep the engine call at `internal/engine/engine.go` about :455 working.
2. Daemon. Add a write method `relay.answer` (*proposed*) to `wire.go`, `handlers.go` and `client.go`, with params project, run, question, option or text, by and via, in a new `internal/daemon/relayanswer.go` beside `adjwrite.go`. Refuse with no write in these cases:
   - the project is not registered;
   - the run is ended or is not in the project's ledger;
   - the question is not on the run or is already answered;
   - the option is not one the question offers;
   - by is empty;
   - the run is linked to an engine run.
   Write the ledger answer first, then refresh the cache. When the question has a `key`, the project uses adj, and `Adj.Check` reports the key open as #N, also answer #N through the S172 path (`engine.AnswerRecord`, Via `tui`) with the same option or text. Otherwise answer the ledger only. The result message says what was written and why adj was skipped or failed. An adj failure after the ledger write is not an error.
3. TUI. Add a helper in `relayboard.go` beside `ledgerOwnerQuestion` (about :467) that finds the latest unanswered question on any step of a live, non-stale, unlinked run, blocker or not. Leave Needs you and counts as they are: they still follow `ledgerOwnerQuestion`. The ledger pane (`pane.go` about :468-482) numbers the options and offers `1-N pick; t free text` while an answer would go out. A new `internal/tui/relayanswer.go` reuses the S185 flow in `decisionanswer.go`:
   - the confirm reads `Answer #QID (Title) on RUN as "X" (recommended) in the ledger [and adj #N] as NAME? [y/N] (Enter is No)`, with the keys on their own line when it does not fit;
   - flights are keyed per run and question;
   - `By` comes from `ADJ_DECIDED_BY`;
   - refusals show verbatim;
   - the pane closes and refreshes on success.
   Update the hints in `keys.go` and the help in `view.go`.
4. Docs. Update `docs/dashboard.md`: the sentence at about :793-801 says answering stays with whoever started the run. Also update the design.md wire section.
5. Run `go test ./internal/tui -update` and review the diff.

Owner decisions 2026-10-30 (interactive, spec drafting):
- Pull S112 into v1.0.
- The answer form is the same as S185 (1-4 pick, t free text, confirm, --by from ADJ_DECIDED_BY, no why field).
- Any unanswered question on a live run is answerable, blocker or not. A stale run still offers only x end run.
- When the question carries an adj key that names an open record, ork also answers that record via adj.answer, and one confirm covers both.
- The answer goes out through a new daemon method; the TUI never calls slicer.

Not in this slice:

- answers on stale runs;
- a why field;
- Needs you counts for non-blocker questions;
- contract v11 (S198).
